newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Arab Insurance Group plans public share offering.
newsitem.headline: Arab Insurance Group plans public share offering.

text.p: One of the Arab world's largest insurers, Arab Insurance Group (ARIG), said on Wednesday it planned to offer shares worth some $180 million to private investors later this year.
"This morning we received the approval and support of ARIG shareholders to carry out the plan," chairman and chief executive Abdul-Wahab al-Tammar told reporters.

This is the first time the public will be able to hold shares in Bahrain-based ARIG -- owned equally by the governments of the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait and Libya -- since the company was established some 16 years ago.
"New shares will be offered to the public in Arab states. A total of 180 million shares will be offered...this year."

When asked if foreign investors would be allowed to take part in the offering, Tammar said: "Shares will be offered to eligible investors...according to the laws of countries where the shares will be offered."
Foreign ownership of local equities is restricted in many Arab countries.
Tammar said the shares, which would be listed on the Bahrain Stock Exchange, would carry a face value of $1 each but the issue price would be determined later.
He said the offering would be managed and underwritten by the National Bank of Kuwait and Saudi Arabia's National Commercial Bank.
"After the completion of this operation, the issued shares of ARIG will be 360 million shares in total," Tammar said.
ARIG has two units -- ARIG Reinsurance and ARIG Insurance Investments -- a London-based subsidiary called ARIG Insurance and Asian and African branches based in Hong Kong and Tunis.
Officials said ARIG, which lifted net profit in 1996 by 16 percent to $42.36 million, expects premium income of $320 million-350 million this year, up from $300 million in 1996.
ARIG activites include reinsurance, insurance investment and medical insurance. It plans to introduce life insurance and other products, including Islamic insurance products, soon.
